skill_name: Compare the experience of visiting two different historical monuments.
workflow: Visiting the Parthenon in Athens is an awe-inspiring experience. The Parthenon stands atop the Acropolis and overlooks the city below. It is a symbol of the Golden Age of Greece, and the art and architecture create a stunning view. On the other hand, visiting the Colosseum in Rome is a humbling experience.
